We utilize open-source multimodal large language models (MLLM) and large language models (LLM) for the automated annotation of mined image pairs P = {(I q , I t i )}. Initially, each image pair (I q , I t i ) is processed by the MLLM to generate a detailed description D i of the common concepts and differences between the query image I q and the target image I t i . This description D i is then refined by the LLM to produce textual instructions T q→t i .
